title: Privacy Policy — Vote-Scope
description: Vote-Scope's privacy policy — a free static site with no accounts, privacy-conscious audience measurement, consent controls, and your rights in plain language.
intro: Vote-Scope (vote-scope.com) is a fully free, static website specializing in electoral and sports intelligence. The site has no user accounts or signup form and does not ask visitors to submit identifying information. This policy explains the limited technical and audience data processed by our providers, our consent controls, and your rights. Last updated August 2026.
callout: In short: we minimize measurement, do not sell personal information, and require consent before activating Google Analytics or Microsoft Clarity where required.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.bodyHtml:
Vote-Scope is served by Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare may process standard technical data such as an abbreviated IP address, browser and device category, referring page, pages visited and timestamps to deliver and secure the site and provide aggregate Web Analytics.

With your consent where required, Vote-Scope also uses Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity through Cloudflare Zaraz. We measure overall audience and controlled interactions with maps, tables, charts and links. Clarity provides heatmaps and session replays that help us identify usability problems. Clarity uses balanced masking for sensitive content and form fields. We do not intentionally send names, email addresses, riding-search text or URL query strings.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.bodyHtml: Vote-Scope does not maintain visitor accounts, profiles, or its own database of personal information. Cloudflare, Google and Microsoft retain limited technical or analytics data according to their respective settings and policies. We configure Zaraz to remove URL query parameters, trim IP addresses, clean user-agent strings and block automated traffic before analytics tools are activated.

sections.title: Measurement tools and third-party technologies
sections.bodyHtml:
Cloudflare Web Analytics provides aggregate, cookie-free audience and performance measurement. Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity are configured through Cloudflare Zaraz and assigned to the Audience measurement consent purpose. Zaraz's consent manager controls whether they are activated; neither tool loads when that purpose is refused. You can accept, refuse or change your choice through the consent interface. Learn more in Microsoft's privacy statement.

Some content may come from third parties (Polymarket widgets, Substack embeds, video players, etc.). These services are governed by their own privacy policies. Vote-Scope does not use analytics data to create advertising profiles or track visitors across unrelated websites.

sections.title: Partners, advertising and future features
sections.bodyHtml: The site may, now or in the future, integrate content, widgets, advertising, partnerships, or features from third parties. These partners are independent and governed by their own policies. Vote-Scope is not responsible for their privacy practices. Any new feature (advertising, sponsorships, API, etc.) will be reflected in this policy. Refusing third-party trackers does not change the experience we offer you.

sections.title: The Vibe Match game
sections.bodyHtml:
The Vibe Match game shows you cards to swipe, then compares our guess with the party you name. Those answers calibrate the model. Here is exactly what they contain.

What is never collected: no email, no name, no IP address, no age, no gender, no session identifier or cookie that could link you from one visit to the next. We create no account and no profile.

Your postal code never reaches us. If you choose to enter one to find your riding, it is converted into a riding inside your browser, on your device. Only the riding travels; the postal code itself is never transmitted, recorded, or stored anywhere.

What is sent when you answer the final question: your card answers, the party our model proposed, the party you named, how well you felt it read you, the site language, your riding if you chose one, and the date. Nothing else. A random identifier tells questionnaires apart without pointing to anyone.

Why it is anonymous and stays that way. Quebec's smallest riding holds several thousand voters, and the game is built so that no combination of answers can single out a person: it asks nothing that would distinguish you. That is a design decision, not a happy accident.

Our partners have no access. These answers are not passed to Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, our advertising provider, or any third party. They feed no ad targeting and are never sold.

Retention. Individual questionnaires are deleted after 90 days at the latest. The database's point-in-time backup may hold them for up to 30 days more, so 120 days in total. Only aggregate statistics — which describe no one — are kept beyond that. An automatic purge runs daily and is monitored.

On your device. Your game in progress is saved in your browser's local storage so you can pick it back up. It is yours: clearing the site's data erases it for good.

sections.title: Security
sections.bodyHtml: We use reasonable technical measures (HTTPS, static architecture, secure hosting via Cloudflare) to protect the site and limit risk. No system, however, is entirely immune to incidents.

sections.title: Breach notification
sections.bodyHtml: In the unlikely event of a security breach involving personal information, we will promptly investigate and notify affected individuals as well as the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC), in accordance with PIPEDA requirements, and take appropriate steps to limit harm.

sections.title: Third-party content and services
sections.bodyHtml: Vote-Scope may display or link to third-party services (Polymarket, Substack, etc.). These services are independent and have their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for their practices.

sections.title: Children
sections.bodyHtml: The site is intended for a general adult audience interested in electoral and sports analysis. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.bodyHtml: Because we collect and retain virtually no personal data, most requests for access, correction, or deletion will have no data to act on. If you believe we hold information about you, contact us and we will respond promptly.

sections.title: Accountability and jurisdiction
sections.bodyHtml: Kim Leclerc is responsible for compliance with this policy. Vote-Scope is operated from Ontario, Canada. This policy is governed by the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and the applicable laws of Ontario.

sections.title: Changes
sections.bodyHtml: We may update this policy as the site evolves (including if we add partners, advertising, or new features). Material changes will be indicated by an updated date.

sections.title: Contact
sections.bodyHtml: For any privacy question: Kim Leclerc — kimleclerc.ca.
